description: Verify that DUT can receive UDP at the same destination port from two distinct hosts (RFC 768 'Fields')
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of FIELDS_04: DUT must accept and report receipt of UDP datagrams arriving at the same dst_port but originating from different src_ip values. tc8-dut overwrites its last_receipt slot on each probe; the SCXML observes only the UT Confirmation that carries the per-phase expected src_ip.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Phase 1 (synchronous):
   • Tester → DUT: UDP probe with src_ip = Host-1-IP, dst_port = K
   • Tester → DUT: OpGetReceivedUdp UT-query
   • Observation: UT Confirmation reports src_ip == Host-1-IP

2. Phase 2 (scheduled on Listening_phase2 entry):
   • Tester → DUT: UDP probe with src_ip = Host-2-IP, dst_port = K
   • Tester → DUT: OpGetReceivedUdp UT-query
   • Observation: UT Confirmation reports src_ip == Host-2-IP

[Pass condition]
Both UT-query confirmations report the matching per-phase expected src_ip.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase1_no_host1_receipt — UT confirmation missing for Host-1 phase
• Fail_phase2_no_host2_receipt — UT confirmation missing for Host-2 phase

verdicts.Pass: DUT received UDPs from two distinct hosts on the same dst_port — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_host1_receipt: No UT confirmation for Host-1 receipt
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_host2_receipt: No UT confirmation for Host-2 receipt
